## Generate GTIN-14 test values for ecommerce product feed QA with Ecomwith

### How it works

This workflow collects GTIN generation inputs through a form, logs the raw submission, and normalizes the data for an API request. It then calls the Ecomwith GTIN API to generate GTIN-14 test values for ecommerce product feed QA. The workflow formats either the successful GTIN result or an API error response for review.

### Setup steps

- Configure the GTIN Form fields to capture quantity and SKU prefix.
- Set up the data table used by Log raw form input so submissions remain traceable.
- Verify the Ecomwith API endpoint, request method, headers, and credential in Call Ecomwith GTIN API.
- Review the code nodes if you customize form field names or output columns.
- Keep this workflow inactive until the credential and API smoke test pass.

### Customization

Adjust the form fields and normalization code for different GTIN-14 test scenarios, such as batch sizes or SKU conventions. Learn more at https://ecomwith.com/tools/gtin and manage the API key at https://ecomwith.com/settings/apikeys. These are format-valid QA values, not official GS1 assignments.

## Collect and prepare input

Captures the user's GTIN test-value request, logs the raw submission, and normalizes quantity and SKU prefix into the structure expected by the Ecomwith API. Quantity is bounded to 1–100 and the SKU prefix is trimmed before the request. The raw form row is retained for traceability.

## Generate and format GTINs

Sends the normalized request to POST https://ecomwith.com/api/v1/tools/gtin/generate with an Idempotency-Key, then formats generated GTIN-14 values into SKU-to-GTIN rows with quota and rate-limit metadata. API failures become reviewable error objects with retry guidance. Tool details: https://ecomwith.com/tools/gtin
